messages:
Asha: Hi team, Asha here  first day! Trying to bootstrap my dev environment on an M2 Mac (Ventura). Running into asdf build failures for Python 3.11 and node 18. Followed the README but `python-build` errors out with missing readline/ssl. Any quick checklist for what to brew and what env vars to set?

tyler: welcome Asha :wave: Quick checklist I always do: 1) Install Homebrew to /opt/homebrew, 2) brew install openssl@1.1 readline sqlite3 xz zlib tcl-tk, 3) `brew install gpg libffi` for plugins.

nina: if you use fish, make sure your shell init is in ~/.config/fish/config.fish rather than zsh files. asdf looks for env vars in the shell that launches it. For fish add lines like `set -x LDFLAGS "-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/lib"` and similar for CPPFLAGS/PKG_CONFIG_PATH.

Asha: oh interesting, I'm on fish + direnv. Do I export env vars in .envrc or in fish config?

tyler: put build flags in your shell config so asdf sees them during compile. For runtime stuff you can use .envrc for project-specific keys. Example for zsh: `export LDFLAGS=...` but in fish use `set -x`.

nina: also run the dotfiles bootstrap which symlinks asdf plugins and installs recommended brew pkgs: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/dotfiles.git && cd dotfiles && ./bootstrap --skip-vscode`. It will not touch your secrets. dotfiles-bot: note added: bootstrap creates ~/.asdf/plugins and writes plugin list.

Asha: got a GPG prompt when adding the nodejs plugin - it asked to import keys and then errored. Is this normal?

tyler: yes, run `brew install gpg` then `bash ~/.asdf/plugins/nodejs/bin/import-release-team-keyring` (some asdf node plugins require this). If it errors with pinentry, you might need `brew install pinentry-mac` and `gpgconf --reload gpg-agent`.

nina: for Python builds, sometimes the system SDK causes trouble. Try `export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@1.1/include -I/opt/homebrew/opt/sqlite/include"` and `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"` before `asdf install python 3.11.6`.

Asha: do we prefer pyenv vs asdf for Python?

tyler: we standardize on asdf for language runtimes so the team has reproducible .tool-versions and the CI matches local. If you need global overrides talk to your manager.

infra-bot: created ticket ONB-519 for Asha. Please add your public SSH key to GitHub now so infra can grant repo access. Also join the onboarding Zoom at 3pm.

Asha: thanks! One more: 1Password CLI login flow for secrets in dev?

nina: install op via brew `brew install 1password-cli` then `eval $(op signin my)` to get a session; but for local dev we often store a .envrc stub and use direnv to load secrets from 1Password using a small script in dotfiles. Don't commit the .envrc values.

tyler: if you want, I can pair for 15 mins now and help get node/python installed and your ssh key added. Ping me. :thumbsup:

Asha: I'll DM you! Thanks all  this was super helpful.
